file_roles.evidence: The commit was unguarded, so a throw from 'commitOffsetsOrTransaction(consumedOffsetsAndMetadataPerTask)' skipped everything after it, including the clean close. It is wrapped in try/catch with a fallback, 'log.error("Failed to commit tasks that are prepared to close clean, will close them as dirty instead", e); dirtyTasks.addAll(checkpointPerTask.keySet()); checkpointPerTask.clear();'. Leaving tasks neither committed nor closed is the defect.

rationale: The throw is 'IllegalStateException: RocksDB metrics recorder for store ... of task 2_2 has already been added. This is a bug in Kafka Streams.' at 'RocksDBMetricsRecordingTrigger.addMetricsRecorder(RocksDBMetricsRecordingTrigger.java:30)', reached while initializing the task again. The recorder was still registered because an earlier close never finished, which the reporter states directly: 'if we fail to do the commit during task close section, the actual closeClean call could not be triggered'. The leftover registration is produced on one path and tripped over on another.
notes: The gold file does appear in the trace, at 'TaskManager.tryToCompleteRestoration(TaskManager.java:329)', but that is the re-initialization path and the fix is in the close path around line 235. Right file, wrong method, which is the same shape as KAFKA-3123, and again the frame cannot show the real site because the call that caused the damage had already returned. Note also that the message the exception carries, 'This is a bug in Kafka Streams', is an assertion in a third file that is neither the cause nor in gold. REPORT-NAMES-FIX: the reporter gives the mechanism in the last sentence of the report.
